card.name: Missed or vomited dose instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, to, not, the, should) right after a missed or vomited dose, where the label says to skip it and resume the usual schedule.

modes.label: The skip-and-resume wording
modes.description: The word "and" joining skipping a dose with resuming the next scheduled dose.
modes.example: skip the dose<< and>> resume dosing with the next scheduled dose

modes.label: The wording against repeating a dose after vomiting
modes.description: Small words in an instruction not to take an extra dose after vomiting.
modes.example: instruct the patient not<< to>> take an additional dose and take the next
